role: The Item base class and the static item registry: registerItems() builds every 1.7.10 item object (id 256..4226) and every ItemBlock subclass for the block registry, and the class carries the stack/damage/subtype state and the use, eat, tool, naming and icon hook methods every item subclass overrides.
scope_reason: Items are core gameplay on both sides; only the specific switched-off uses (maps, fishing, fireworks, books, boats, minecarts, anvil repair) are forced off in world.conf.

members.name: statics: itemRegistry, field_111210_e, itemRand
members.note: the registry is the generated ITEMS[4096] table (netherite.oracle.ItemTable writes it from the live oracle objects); itemRand's draws are the per-role stream item_rand_float

members.name: tabToDisplayOn, maxStackSize, maxDamage, bFull3D, hasSubtypes, containerItem, potionEffect, unlocalizedName, itemIcon, iconString
members.note: maxStackSize, maxDamage, hasSubtypes and bFull3D are the generated ITEMS rows; containerItem is the buckets' (the furnace fuel give-back and the crafting grid's), potionEffect the brewing strings (world.conf brewing = off); the tab, the names and the icons are client text and atlas lookups.
